{{Quote|I haven't been back to Krownest since before my time at the Imperial Academy, Ezra. And I didn't exactly leave on good terms.|Sabine Wren|<ref name="Legacy of Mandalore" />}}
'''Krownest''' was an [[Water|icy]] [[Planet|world]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories]]' [[Mandalore sector]], [[Temperature|cold]] and covered in snow. [[Mountain]]ous terrain and evergreen [[forest]]s comprised much of Krownest's frigid landscape, and its [[atmosphere]] proved breathable to [[human]]s. A planet under [[Mandalorian]] governance, Krownest was the ancestral home of [[Clan Wren]], a legendary Mandalorian family whose [[Soldier|warriors]] possessed a [[Wren Stronghold|stronghold]] on the snowy world, built along the edge of a frozen [[lake]].

Two [[Standard year|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin]], the Mandalorian rebel [[Sabine Wren]] traveled to Krownest with the intent to enlist the aid of Clan Wren against the [[Imperial Era|reigning]] [[Galactic Empire]]. Despite initial [[Skirmish on Krownest|hostilities]] between Sabine and her estranged family, and an attack on the Wrens' stronghold by a group of Mandalorian [[Imperial Super Commando|super commandos]] in the employ of the Empire, Sabine and her [[Parent|mother]] [[Ursa Wren]] were able to reconcile after years spent apart. However, during the super commandos' attack, Ursa had been forced to [[Death|kill]] the Imperial [[governor]] [[Gar Saxon]] in order to save her daughter's life, and the resulting [[Mandalorian Civil War (Imperial Era)|civil war]] that ensued between the Wren and [[Clan Saxon|Saxon clans]] kept the Mandalorians from fully supporting the larger rebellion against the Empire. Even still, Clan Wren sent several warriors and a [[squadron]] of [[Fang-class Protectorate fighter|Fang starfighters]] from Krownest to aid the besieged rebels on [[Atollon]] during the Empire's [[Battle of Atollon|attack]] on their [[Chopper Base|hidden base]], allowing the insurgents and what remained of their [[fleet]] to escape with their lives.

==Description==
[[File:Wren_Stronghold.png|thumb|left|216x216px|The Wren Stronghold on Krownest]]
A frigid [[planet]],<ref name="Legacy of Mandalore" /> Krownest was located in the [[Mandalore sector]] of [[the galaxy]]'s [[Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Rebels Recon" /> Krownest was a terrestrial world blanketed in [[Water|ice]] and snow, possessing a cold climate<ref name="KrownestDatabank" /> and an [[atmosphere]] breathable to [[human]]s.<ref name="Legacy of Mandalore" /> The planet's terrain was largely comprised of [[mountain]]ous regions<ref name="KrownestDatabank" /> dotted with forests of tall evergreen [[tree]]s.<ref name="Legacy of Mandalore" /> Winter on Krownest lasted for much of the year, but the plants, most of which were evergreen produced a natural antifreeze, allowing them to grow, even in the snow. The planet's wildlife also adapted to the cold, thanks to thick, furry coats and large reserves of fat.<ref name="SWECG">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]''</ref>

A [[Mandalorian]] world, Krownest was the ancestral [[Homeworld|home]] of [[Clan Wren]],<ref name="Legacy of Mandalore" /> a legendary family of Mandalorian [[Soldier|warriors]]<ref name="ClanWren">{{Databank|clan-wren|Clan Wren}}</ref>, who constructed a fortified [[Wren Stronghold|stronghold]] on Krownest along the banks of a frozen [[lake]]. The Wrens' complex, built from [[steel]] and [[glass]], blended elegantly into the snowy landscape of Krownest.<ref name="WrenStronghold">{{Databank|wren-stronghold|Wren Stronghold}}</ref> At least one member of Clan Wren monitored traffic around Krownest, and [[Starship|vessels]] entering the planet's airspace would be met either by a cadre of the clan's [[jetpack]]-equipped soldiers<ref name="Legacy of Mandalore" /> or a [[squadron]] of [[Fang-class Protectorate fighter|Fang starfighters]].<ref name="ZeroHour">{{Rebels|Zero Hour}}</ref>

==History==
Conquered by the [[Mandalorian crusaders]],<ref name="Official Magazine">{{GermanFanCite|104|Database}}</ref> Krownest became home to the legendary warriors of the Mandalorian Wren clan, and acted as the clan's seat of power well into the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. Prior to entering the [[Imperial Academy of Mandalore|Imperial Academy]]<ref name="Legacy of Mandalore" /> on [[Mandalore]],<ref name="SWR:The Visual Guide">''[[Star Wars Rebels: The Visual Guide]]''</ref> [[Sabine Wren]] spent a period of [[time]] on Krownest in her youth. Her eventual departure from the snowy world did not come about on good terms, and the young Mandalorian [[Gender|woman]] subsequently did not return to Krownest for many [[Standard year|years]] after.<ref name="Legacy of Mandalore" />

[[File:Sabine_shows_darksaber.png|thumb|right|256x256px|On Krownest, Sabine Wren reunited with her estranged family]]
That finally changed in [[2 BBY]],<ref name="Date note">''[[Dawn of Rebellion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars Rebels: Steps Into Shadow]]'' seventeen [[Standard year|years]] after the end of the [[Clone Wars]], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates to [[19 BBY]]; therefore, the events of ''Steps Into Shadow'' must take place in [[2 BBY]]. According to ''[[Star Wars: On the Front Lines]]'', [[Mon Mothma]]'s denunciation of the [[Galactic Empire]] and the [[Declaration of the Rebel Alliance]] take place 2 years before the [[Battle of Yavin]] or [[2 BBY]]. As "[[Legacy of Mandalore]]" is set between ''Steps Into Shadow'' and "Secret Cargo," the events of the episode must also take place in 2 BBY.</ref> when Sabine—along with [[Spectres|several members]] of the nascent rebellion against the Empire—journeyed to Krownest in an attempt to persuade her estranged [[Parent|mother]] and clan leader, [[Ursa Wren]], to ally her people with the rebels in their fight against the Imperial forces. Though the [[Phantom II|rebels' ship]] was initially forced down to Krownest's snowy surface while [[Skirmish on Krownest|under fire]] from Mandalorian [[troop]]s, Sabine and her allies were finally given safe passage to meet with her mother at the Wren Stronghold once her identity was confirmed. During the ensuing talks, Mandalorian [[Imperial Super Commando|super commandos]] loyal to the Empire arrived on Krownest in pursuit of the rebels, led by Imperial [[Viceroy]] [[Gar Saxon]]. At the Wren Stronghold, Saxon declared Clan Wren guilty of colluding with the rebellion and ordered their [[Death|executions]], leading to a [[Blaster|shootout]] between Saxon's super [[commando]]s and the forces of Clan Wren. The firefight quickly came down to a [[Lightsaber duel|duel]] between Saxon and Sabine Wren, spilling out from the stronghold onto one of Krownest's frozen lakes, where Saxon was ultimately defeated and slain. While Sabine's rebel allies departed the snowy world in the battle's aftermath, she instead chose to remain on Krownest with her mother and clan.<ref name="Legacy of Mandalore" />

Later, during the Empire's devastating [[Battle of Atollon|assault]] on the rebellion's [[Chopper Base|base of operations]] on [[Atollon]], the young rebel and [[Jedi]]-in-[[Jedi training|training]] [[Ezra Bridger]] fled to Krownest, to once again ask Clan Wren for their aid against the Empire. At the Wren Stronghold, Bridger informed the Mandalorians of the Imperial attack, only to learn that Clan Wren had become embroiled in a [[Mandalorian Civil War (Imperial Era)|civil war]] with the Imperial-aligned [[Clan Saxon]] in the time since Gar Saxon's death. Though their forces were spread thin, Ursa Wren chose to allow her daughter Sabine and a group of volunteers from Clan Wren to depart Krownest with Bridger in order to reinforce the besieged rebels on Atollon. The Mandalorian volunteers arrived in the [[Atollon system]] soon after, and due to their efforts the Imperial [[Interdictor]] vessel positioned over Atollon was ultimately destroyed, allowing numerous rebel ships and personnel to escape the planet and continue the fight against the Empire.<ref name="ZeroHour" />

==Behind the scenes==
Krownest first appeared in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the sixteenth episode of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]''{{'}} [[Star Wars Rebels Season Three|third season]], entitled "[[Legacy of Mandalore]]" which originally aired on [[February 18]], [[2017]].
